completenessNote: 全文，共 3 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1991/ra_7093_1991.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: The name of the Alangalang Agro-Industrial School in Alangalang, Leyte, is hereby changed to Leyte State School of Agriculture.

The College shall offer secondary course in agriculture, short-term technical or vocational courses, and higher technological and professional instruction and training in agricultural and industrial fields as may be authorized by the Department of Education, Culture and Sports.
This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
